name: ci-that-cannot-fail
defect: The generated .github/workflows/ci.yml ends its Build and Test steps with `| xcbeautify || true`, so a failing test exits zero and the workflow is green on a broken build.
why: DR4-023, reproduced by this repo's own devops agent while working inside a repo built around the sentence forbidding it. A rule that cannot fail is worse than no rule, and until ship-gate §5 landed nothing inspected generated CI at all.
